answer: One workable design: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because meadow only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, jetty is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any zenith approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
